This is the playbook `/big` command for Codex. Run it as `$playbook-big`. The text after the skill name is `$ARGUMENTS`. Where a step names the `Agent` tool, `subagent_type`, `SendMessage` or `AskUserQuestion` and they are not available, do that step yourself or ask in chat.

Read `references/playbook-body.md` and follow it. Resolve every relative path in it from this skill folder, not from the body file.
